title: Noise sensitivity
statement: For $\delta\in[0,1]$ and a Boolean function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, its noise sensitivity at rate $\delta$ is the probability that $f(x)\ne f(y)$ when $(x,y)$ is drawn from the correlated pair distribution with parameter $1-2\delta$.
